notes.title: Dev Log #27 – Power, Style, and More Realism
notes.content:
[h2][b]Dev Log #27 – Power, Style, and More Realism[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39200590/0c8c0c7bdde4031d6a172a63b8156bdee7da06ec.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Hello Builders,[/h2][h3]The construction site is getting busier than ever. With this update, we focused on bringing more realism and new systems into your projects, while also expanding the possibilities of customization.[/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Materials and Finishing[/b][/h3][p]We’ve introduced a wide range of wall structures, paints, and floor finishes, allowing you to personalize both interiors and exteriors. Materials are now aligned using a World Alignment system, so large surfaces look more natural and avoid repetitive patterns.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39200590/fbeb12b9d7024064f25e47d9cd5da68c0524412b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39200590/646cbc68fd1c15eecd544a2f000b62b51ca0be59.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39200590/95df32a3929a5ddac79d4ef231e4faad968b9294.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Electrical Installations[/b][/h3][p]A brand-new electrical system is now part of construction. You can build a complete power network with a switchboard, sockets, and light switches. Electricity flows realistically through the network, and everything can be tested in-game.[/p][p]To make things easier, we’ve also added a cable scanner. Even if your walls are already plastered, you can still visualize where the hidden wires are running.[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39200590/aa5a017420b915ead443336f9054f04690e1905d.png"][/img][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39200590/eb240c5d8f6a67cfe6fb426cd7c5e158c8ffd3ed.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39200590/35c244923de897299a72824f73fb4f8ad05f2bca.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Wooden Assembly[/b][/h3][p]We added a wood paneling module, where you can attach panels and decorative elements to walls using a hammer tool that appears in your hand during work.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39200590/84a85c598b3c2f0d3535e82f3d7d7a3874416e5c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39200590/0300394dc83eeb995d4c0ff2f0f75c7946400792.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]HUD Improvements[/b][/h3][p]The HUD has been expanded with new modules to support the growing systems: materials, electricity, and construction elements. At the same time, we’ve started developing a brand-new interface that will eventually replace the current HUD in a future update.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Expanding the World[/b][/h3][p]The environment around your building site has been improved with new background elements and higher-quality distant objects, increasing immersion and depth in the world.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Future Foundations[/b][/h3][p]We’ve prepared the groundwork for water and sewage systems, as well as the first code structures for basement construction and excavation with heavy machinery. These are still in development, but they set the stage for even more advanced building mechanics in upcoming updates.[/p][p]We’re getting closer to a true full-scale construction experience, and this update brings us one big step forward.[/p][p]Yours,[/p][p]Desand Game Studios[/p][p]Dreamhouse: The Game Team[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39200590/73dd84b5c5b53940b7125626ec17fea16bd1347e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Devlog #26 Higher, Smarter, Better
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Builders![/h1][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39200590/15873fc1699669373bdf85b7b83b76093c03cc36.png"][/img][/p][h2]Last time, we introduced snow and rooftops. This time, we're taking you deeper into the construction site — because a lot has changed.[/h2][p]The most important news first: [b]we’ve moved the entire project to Unreal Engine 5[/b].[/p][p]This decision allowed us to fully redesign our workflow and push the game forward in both visuals and gameplay complexity. With the power of UE5, we now support high-fidelity lighting through Lumen, detailed environments, and more scalable building mechanics[/p][h3]
[b]What’s new?[/b][/h3][p]We’ve built a fully functional [b]house construction system[/b] from the ground up. You can now:[/p][list][*][p]Lay down foundations, build walls, floors, and ceilings[/p][/*][*][p]Snap everything to a dynamic grid system with proper alignment[/p][/*][*][p]Insert windows and doors with automatic wall cutouts[/p][/*][*][p]Preview every item before placing it[/p][/*][*][p]Rotate, delete, and paint walls using an in-game UI
[/p][/*][/list][p]You can also [b]build vertically[/b]. The game now supports multi-story construction with stairs, floor toggling, and visibility control. You can switch floors, hide or reveal levels, and continue building without visual clutter.
[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXepMqmdMAPHjm1df_6lqh_rZbXLXEfytCAOAU6tLwheTMocMa3122YXyRhZHe16M1rNVAgA1E5xD8Szm4JKwSociMUFuhZ5lIUo34jHktLoQ5dO8sN7xUe0ko0kjzv7syk58LQGTA?key=HjiEbDR59WOPdfm0A4M1xA"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcTBbWE5X6IiJrE9uhS9vXXUgTl8haxHE0PP9_yJ-Z7knQHInA8lxFW5D_XUjyl5Y9LYycNF0HZajPzJ3c3wXKrp7L7XO6TJ4teOrVKuxA6EdnfxhDSyjaOwBHbcCe_6O_aGBpZow?key=HjiEbDR59WOPdfm0A4M1xA"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeYhtpxUuGekRoYVamENwsHrmIFwQoIk3qEjcyv23KnAls6T3Lt1NW0c5fMqCT9NCQQJKLbuGjSnIKYabr85i5RDKmjl1TKAaGyt6eFItKA9LJIkHgZkgyuA2PfqZFgCvFrAAUK?key=HjiEbDR59WOPdfm0A4M1xA"][/img]  [/p][p][/p][p]To support more realistic construction workflows, we added:[/p][list][*][p]A wall finishing system with layers: insulation, plaster, paint[/p][/*][*][p]A paint roller tool and plaster gun with animated effects[/p][/*][*][p]Scaffolding and ladders for reaching upper levels[/p][/*][*][p]A revamped UI/HUD with tool categories, icons, and progress indicators

[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]And beyond the house...[/b][/h3][p]The world outside your construction site is no longer empty. We’ve introduced:[/p][list][*][p]3D terrain, vegetation, and background objects[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamic lighting and weather effects across the environment[/p][/*][*][p]Full day-night cycles and support for advanced rendering features like Ray Tracing, Path Tracing, and HDR[/p][/*][/list][p]A graphics settings menu, performance profiling, and fallback modes for lower-spec machines[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXehsoeMOOHxu7AAorglU_eaafX4tK7yQ5rdEYDlg-mVp6slc8tWCVPSYzVdqcMEm9uq91-jg1p28umkKXmtGm3CSbHn_ynXw3zhwmbcd9cfIF3G3q6kzUhJzU--T6s2Ts9VgcUtJg?key=HjiEbDR59WOPdfm0A4M1xA"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXehZCVUveoboqKwHJgTpXVMbCgPP8ptUisipof2AUhc-6WMASde5YOroe_IyRjVl52JlvOOaiDYaQz1lTqeoxFAr7iNzqUVYToYZo26BGxkf_Cvg5kKmGbz42ca7EvHyNG6cu3gcQ?key=HjiEbDR59WOPdfm0A4M1xA"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXctpfrlzReDtJ6Uf5RUf2rHzinWK4Qe_9rHJAX5Cv3dq2_3yhzDqgK9UthMCIr_FbyjSQzfxpyELOnBsDH3zibfEvzsH6OjzR8a17Sxy00aRvx5JzULSMujUW5BDXXPY6KuJyUXQQ?key=HjiEbDR59WOPdfm0A4M1xA"][/img][/p][p]This is the biggest leap we've made so far — technically and creatively. We're now laying the groundwork for more advanced gameplay systems, deeper mechanics, and visual polish.[/p][p]Until next time – stay warm, and keep building.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcPOQ8jhzMPmZ5stI1w0Vmimywbgoo7OBCTpxzsmdQlZ8n1ftJ0HBswVXD6EScxMX-InooEguhu971xEcPd8otfJQp0-9JoRqnvEhdhHsFR0-cOniYfeL81cg10pjC3TMk5BtAAyA?key=HjiEbDR59WOPdfm0A4M1xA"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcDCXLThaUjxgUlG3DgjNk87SyKz6ZXMeLvbhFm__ynmDUOHIyFccT7apwt5opPf5a6uQ4xjcPB4m1SMKjx5erlDXttlyVEduU6-D3b9X-U8VyZs9vCQbTS2GPsLqiSTbceqGSI?key=HjiEbDR59WOPdfm0A4M1xA"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Yours,
 Desand Game Studios
 [i]Dreamhouse: The Game Team[/i][/p][p]

notes.title: Devlog #25 Snow system
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Architects![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39200590/46b43fb9e15e8ca3e65f6557bbc04196b90639fa.png[/img]

[h2]Winter is coming soon, so white down will be added to our production. What can snow bring with it?[/h2]

[previewyoutube=G5_nnIU2BtY;full][/previewyoutube]

Like rain, snow is also created procedurally. Also, as in the case of rain, it is reproduced as real as possible. However, what distinguishes it from rain is the intensity. You can come across a light dry dust or a real blizzard. Therefore, a shelter should be built for such accidents. It is worth mentioning that the roof will fully protect you. So that it is not boring, snow can be together with rain. Currently, snow is only a visual effect. In the future, we may develop it with new mechanics. Perhaps it will be a separate DLC, who knows.

Dress warmly and see you next time.

[i]Yours,
Desand Game Studios "Dreamhouse: The Game" Team[/i]


[i]Join us and talk about the game in the growing community of Architects:[/i]
[url=https://discord.com/invite/PTb2Dg6Uf7][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39200590/73dd84b5c5b53940b7125626ec17fea16bd1347e.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog #24 Rain system
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Architects![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39200590/ab74910e9d6199e927227eb66911683c7096f866.png[/img]

We'll talk about rain in this devlog. Let's start with the fact that rainfall is not only a weather condition, but it has more effects than you think. What do we mean?

Thanks to the procedural actions, our rain creates wet surfaces. This gives an interesting visual effect that makes it feel very real. When it attacks one spot, a puddle appears. 
Moreover, when the drops hit the surface of the resulting puddle, they do so with greater force, which makes their dynamics significantly different from other surfaces.

[previewyoutube=G5KqAVvhDHQ;full][/previewyoutube]

If you decide to build a place to protect against rain, e.g. a roof, you do not have to worry that something will leak on your head. You will not get wet to the dry thread. Small details are also worth mentioning. When rain meets the wall, it will run off, similarly to glass. For now, this is mainly a visual effect that may be developed in the future. 

Remember to take an umbrella with you in such situations. See you next time.


[i]Yours,
Desand Game Studios "Dreamhouse: The Game" Team[/i]


[i]Join us and talk about the game in the growing community of Architects:[/i]
[url=https://discord.com/invite/PTb2Dg6Uf7][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39200590/73dd84b5c5b53940b7125626ec17fea16bd1347e.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog #23 Unreal Engine 5
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Architects![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39200590/c3d421691358c138196f13a18e7cf850e140ab36.png[/img]

In the last devlog we showed you the possibilities of our modular system. Today we come to you with something completely new. 

The work is still ongoing and we have a few new products for you that have appeared recently. Our entire game has been ported to Unreal Engine 5. What does it mean? 

[previewyoutube=xZn6jike27Y;full][/previewyoutube]

When working on the game, we focus on every detail, even the smallest. Hence, the transition of this engine will provide players with a real lighting experience. The in-game day and night cycle will become more natural. It is worth adding that the light will not have a large impact on the smoothness of the game. Players will not have to worry about frame drops. 

To add even more possibilities to the game, everyone will be able to design lighting according to their preferences. So if you like to play with light, every lamp, LED panel, and everything that lights will be at your disposal. 

We hope you like such news. Let me know what you think and see you next time.


[i]Yours,
Desand Game Studios "Dreamhouse: The Game" Team[/i]


[i]Join us and talk about the game in the growing community of Architects:[/i]
[url=https://discord.com/invite/PTb2Dg6Uf7][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39200590/73dd84b5c5b53940b7125626ec17fea16bd1347e.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog #22 Modular system
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Architects![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39200590/b7d8a79ec7a6111df87cfde3b7ab9527dcd15822.png[/img]

It's been a while since our last devlog, sorry for that! We're currently working on technically sensitive issues, so most of our attention is focused on developing the game and testing new mechanics. We would like to unveil the secret and demonstrate to you modular snapping and building system!

We wanted players to be able to take care of the décor in peace, without complicated mechanics. 
Thanks to these mechanics, building and matching interior elements will be much simpler and more affordable to the players. 

Now everyone will easily be able to become an interior decorator. Use your creavity and match the cabinets to each other, as well as place flowers on them, thanks to which every interior will come to life!

notes.title: Devlog #21 Status Update
notes.content:
[h3][b]Greetings Architects![/b][/h3]

We are currently in the heat of development as we have reached a demanding period in game-making, and our keyboards are on fire.

Mechanics and visuals are slowly getting together, and the results look promising. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39200590/d57632db34604d35889990a364dac839c9174bf1.png[/img]

We are exceptionally content with how lightning works and looks in the game so far and it will be only better as we are not accepting anything below "jaw-dropping" quality here! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39200590/d283c39690eb253a3aec018bf633f84fcf8e5a57.png[/img]

As the game grows, new ideas appear, and various experiments occur. 

The original idea of making a game where we have our own construction company and build more and more stuff until we gather enough resources for true wonders of architecture was excellent... on paper. 

At this point, we feel like it's not exactly a direction we want to explore further as it feels bland-ish the more we look at it. 

Worry not, though, as we have a cunning idea of how to put more soul and expand this concept to underline the [b]Dream[/b] in [b]Dream[/b]house :) The basics will remain the same. Players will make glorious or not creations together with all tools possible provided. What will change is the setting and lore.

It will be discussed further in future Devlogs as design work is in progress.

Meanwhile, we would like to share more creations as our building tools are getting better and better.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39200590/335e0b01d3a06abaacebb594d0158781ce28dc00.png[/img]

We also will change the form of Devlogs a little to fit the new setting better, so don't be surprised :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39200590/18c62a12a02089f5349a9a33f847241541d73849.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #20 Building Editor
notes.content:
[h3][b]Greetings Architects![/b][/h3]

Recently we were focused on the building editor. It's going through many experiments regarding how exactly it will be possible to build anything in Dreamhouse. Who needs the freedom of building when it's too hard to build something after all? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39200590/9dca490285868b4e7a5c3ab6f6e37ea2a886eb48.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1468400/view/2944780385322143596]Good lighting[/url] is crucial for the perfect placement of the dreamt house, and we need to make sure all shadows behave and not try to kill us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39200590/4e684b0d2b20175bb0a7359fe5bb856da204bb9b.png[/img]

Simultaneously a lot is happening in the back-end of the system. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1468400/view/3019073227253447709]Snaps, grids and other useful tools[/url] are constantly improved. 

The new addition to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1468400/view/3059610696341842287]procedurally generated goodies[/url]:

Stairs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39200590/2b7d09b4178bfe2f836ff56db9e83cdd4bc4d030.png[/img]

The idea for a system of stairs in Dreamhouse is to quickly build basic stairs by dragging them from menu to level. The number of stairs will be adjusted to the height of rooms.

Stairs placed in this way will allow us to introduce a flexible mezzanine system. We will take an entire future Devlog sometime soon for those, so let's not go into too many details today :)

One can join us and talk about the game in the growing community of Architects on our [url=https://discord.gg/PTb2Dg6Uf7]Discord Server[/url]

notes.title: Devlog #19 "Locations"
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings Architects![/h2]

Since we have come back from our little green trip, it's time to check where We will accomplish our projects.

Dreamhouse: The Game is a multiplayer game and there is a great need to have huge area buildings so You guys can fill it insides with awesome design ideas.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39200590/8c7cc173bc2fe656e6fe2ed26715169b9f863c2d.jpg[/img]

We are not going to stop You from building such constructions by Yourselves. 

It's going to be costly, You will need some help from other people, but it will be worth it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39200590/504a247e64db583316dab812453b49609e3fd7e7.png[/img]

We will populate Los Angeles with such pre-made buildings to make step stones for gathering resources for truly majestic buildings. We need smaller tasks to level up our construction company anyways.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39200590/3f55365df09552e93b85c2471cb3b03b9e381704.jpg[/img]

Do You already have a plan for reconstructing real-world buildings? Please share it with us in the comments or on our Discord Server!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39200590/7b85ae104254c8e24787acfed4f3cc0272a5b01a.png[/img]

Meanwhile, we are preparing a level design for missions and making terraforming mechanics. We have plenty of space to cover ain't we?

notes.title: Devlog #16 New Soundtrack, Inventory UI and Models
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings Architects![/h2]

Today we want to share two new samples of our game soundtrack. You can find them below:
[previewyoutube=XYofEdSpaJs;leftthumb][/previewyoutube][previewyoutube=OO3P8DuAVVo;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]

Recently we have implemented the first iteration of the Inventory UI. We adapted it to the style of other UI windows we presented before. It means a clean and quite minimalistic UI style with a nice outline of the currently selected items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39200590/7ecabbf05e9c50617d36c49a9a4334e493690fec.png[/img]

Currently, we are busy designing levels for missions in our game. It might appear like typical level design stuff but remember. All levels will work on the same principles as the entire building system. It means all walls are destructible, paintable etc. in all desired places as it might be a little weird to hammer the bedroom wall in a mission where You were required only to decorate a garden.

notes.title: Devlog #9 Blueprint system explanation
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings Architects![/h2]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1468400/view/2988675197238257223]In the last devlog[/url] we were talking about walls, bricks and a blueprint system. Currently, we are still working on improvements to said system by increasing its possibilities and making it more user friendly.

Short sneak-peak on the video below:
[previewyoutube=3ws8u4cWIh8;full][/previewyoutube][i]We are posting daily updates from development on our [url=https://discord.gg/PTb2Dg6Uf7]Discord Server[/url]. [/i]

This blueprint system allows us to be very flexible during the creation. It includes manipulating size, the various axes in space, fitting, auto-fitting, and distancing construction elements to another and more.

 We discussed the Grid and Scale system in more detail [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1468400/view/3019073227253447709]HERE[/url].

We believe it might need some explanation of how it's supposed to look like in the end by the example. 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/8co2yUS.png[/img]
In Dreamhouse: The Game, we are playing as construction entrepreneur. To build a single wall with a door and window, we will need to go through few steps:
[olist]
[*] Create a project of a wall with a blueprint system. Since we want to have a door and window in a said wall, we need to leave holes to fit them.
[*] Buy materials in the shop or take it from our magazine (material storage will be a thing to countermeasure demand&supply. We want to earn money in this game)
[*] Recieve said materials on the construction site.
[*] Move material and fit it into a blueprint. We skip the construction process's nuances to focus on the design and tycoon part of the game.
[*] Realise we forgot to make a hole for a window - take a hammer and make it (we lost money on material this way, so be careful! Mistakes cost)
[*] Continue the process with the possibility of making walls like this and more[/olist][img]https://i.imgur.com/nt1qhrk.png[/img][i]We can shape the size of a brick in the wall. There will be a possibility to remove a chosen brick.[/i]
[b]
The construction system will be further developed and improved in the upcoming months.[/b]

Meanwhile, we have noticed Unreal empty plane might be a little too bland to showcase news about Dreamhouse: The Game, so we have created a news studio :)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/JFiA3xV.jpg[/img]
[i]Dreamhouse news coming soon and with style.[/i]

See You in two weeks! 22.04.2021. Or sooner on our [url=https://discord.gg/PTb2Dg6Uf7]Discord Server[/url].

Yours
DeSand "Dreamhouse: The Game" Team

notes.title: Devlog #5 - Objects Manipulation.
Devlog #4 - City of Los Angeles where Everybody is Welcome
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings Architects![/h2]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1468400/announcements/detail/4588572732357201354]In the last devlog[/url] we were talking about sounds in the game and we shared our character creation progress. For now, there is no further update in a subject as work is still in progress.

For that today we will take you on a trip. To Los Angeles, where Everybody is Welcome
[img]https://i.imgur.com/F14YZSP.jpg[/img]
[i]Yes this is Los Angeles reproduced with 1:1 scale detail, say hello if You can see Your living place[/i]

This map was created with the power of the almighty AI system will be used as our in-game map. 
All missions, our Architect Office, points of interest and tradeable properties will appear here. 

The map will not be freely explorable, but your surroundings will depend on your location, so if you buy an apartment in one of the skyscrapers you will see the view very similar to a real place, the same goes for a small house in the suburb.

We thought its good idea for Player to know what points of interest are around the property so we marked it on the map as well.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6VVB82n.png[/img]

[h3]And since it's Los Angeles it looks best at night[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/B1KNO24.png[/img]
[i]Or rather it will look best at night. Most of the graphical tweaks are still before us, for now, we are mostly implementing mechanics.[/i]

The player will be able to move around on 70x50km big city with a free top-down camera. 
For Quality of Life, there will be a list of quick choice and jump to destination.

To visualise its size - we probably would be able to take a screenshot and show one of the city districts from today till the game premiere.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vylp1Ad.jpg[/img]
[i]fun fact - we are going to simulate how the sun behaves on a given day in LA. If you run game today in-game daytime will be same as in Los Angeles. By mean sunrise will be 06:59 and sundown 19:03.[/i]

There won't be much reason to create something if one won't be able to save it. 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/56Ig8QH.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/NZloF7k.png[/img]
[i]Save system is already implemented. We are still wondering what to put in to save cells[/i]

In the next devlog there will be Carnival in Dreamhouse: The Game ;) Hush for now ;)
See You in two weeks! 11.02.2021. Or sooner on our [url=https://discord.gg/PTb2Dg6Uf7]Discord Server[/url].

Yours
DeSand "Dreamhouse: The Game" Team

notes.title: Devlog #3 - Sounds of Dreamhouse
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings Architects![/h2]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1468400/announcements/detail/2908727983578271357]In the last devlog[/url] we have presented how we can create our game avatar so other players can see us.

Today we will focus on how other players can hear us. In Dreamhouse: The Game we are going to implement various grounds and floors and we are currently implementing footsteps sounds with little help of [b]FMOD[/b]. We will share fruits of our "struggles" in next devlog.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/OhLkmAq.png[/img]
[i]Walking on this kind of woodwork simply has to sound sexy. It's our duty as developers![/i]

Meanwhile, we are busy with the multiplayer system. This is a lot of scary back-end styff and we will push the subject further in future devlogs.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NofSenv.png[/img]

We have also added some music to the game! Enjoy:
[previewyoutube=RK47Fm2Rmt4;full][/previewyoutube][i]There are still few bugs here and there but we are overall happy with character creation progress.[/i]

We have noticed some trouble with Youtube preview on Steam so if the video is not working You can check it [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RK47Fm2Rmt4]here[/url]


We have deployed several idle moves, clothes, hairstyles etc. and switching them in character creation menu works fine. We will notify You, Architects when we will put more of those [url=https://linktr.ee/dreamhousegame]so stay tuned with our Social Media.[/url]

In next devlog we will talk about how one chooses missions and move around in Dreamhouse The Game's world. See You in two weeks! 28.01.2021.

Yours
DeSand "Dreamhouse: The Game" Team

notes.title: Devlog #2 - Main Menu and Character Creation
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings Architects![/h2]

Today we will keep it short since everybody is busy celebrating the survival of 2020.
After our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1468400/announcements/detail/2907601525014027064]first devlog [/url] we have received some feedback that we should keep our UI simple and elegant. That's great news for us because we feel the same :)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ONRAlLS.png[/img]
[i]Characters are going to recieve massive graphical improvement later in development process.[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/usK1zvF.png[/img]
[i]For now we are working with mechanics and possibilities. Players already can create their very OWN characters.[/i]

Now we would love to ask You, dear Architects. What do You think about our Main Menu? We are tired of classic "The List" style of menu. This one should be easier to navigate and overall more appealing. You can notice Your character standing in Your office and some "idle" gestures and movements are going to be implemented to put more life into the menu. We are still brainstorming how to improve it further and [b][url=https://discord.gg/PTb2Dg6Uf7]Your feedback is very precious here[/url] :)[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hjCuLAl.jpg[/img]
[i]We believe Player creations should be part of Dreamhouse: The Game main menu[/i]

Now work aside. We would like to wish You, dear reader of this text, [b]Happy New Year![/b]
Yours
[i]DeSand "Dreamhouse: The Game" Team[/i]
Next Devlog in 2 weeks!

notes.title: Devlog #1 - Architects Office
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings Architects![/h2]

[b]At first, we would love to thank You for all positive feedback we have received after publishing our [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-mLcGJf6My4&t=2s]trailer[/url].
It really gives us a massive boost to our motivation to create the best game possible![/b]

Right now we are working about Gamers presence in Dreamhouse World. We already announced multiplayer features in our trailer and proper social experience means - customization.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39200590/1d9220bd150fddf4a1ca4ab8bc2c1a4c9988edab.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39200590/100efb83cec35bfbbe4dc1de32c1eb02be0d1062.gif[/img]

[b]Character creation[/b] UI visuals are still W.i.P but creator itself already allow us to create OWN unique character. Character creation menu will receive some fancy look and features in the nearest future and we will show it in our next Devlog.
We are playing with ideas for now. Should it be simple but elegant? Or maybe scream designer is crazy!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gv94DbS.png[/img]
[i]Totally not a designer look-alike[/i]

Before we lay our first cornerstone, we need Base of Operations. Your very own architect office! 
By mean your own we mean fully customizable office that will serve as an in-game menu as well. 
We cannot wait to see Your imagination go wild with all items and furniture we will provide ;)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Rgugw0j.png[/img]
[i]We are playing with Office mechanics. Should it be visuals only or affect gameplay? Maybe in-game clans should operate together in such? Leave Your feedback in a comment![/i]

You might notice graphics being a little crude for now as its alpha footage ;) Don't worry! 
Trailer level of graphics its MINIMUM we aim for our fully released game. We are going to squeeze Unreal Engine 5 dry!

More about Your office in next Devlog this month ;) 
Add us to Your Wishlist to stay tuned about [b]Dreamhouse: The Game[/b] updates.
Next Devlog in 2 weeks! (31.12.2020)

Yours
[i]DeSand "Dreamhouse: The Game" Team[/i]

notes.title: Dreamhouse: The Game Announcement and Social Media
notes.content:
Welcome Architects!

DeSand Game Studios is happy to announce and show to the community:
[h1]Dreamhouse: The Game[/h1]

We aim to create a place where Players can unleash their inner Architects and allow them to create their very own houses from dreams - together! Experience the process of creating houses like never before in a photo-realistic Unreal Engine 5 game that feature:


[u]Multiplayer/online co-op mode[/u] – Build Dreams together!
[u]Different surroundings[/u] - cabin in a forest, a house in the mountains, hacienda on a beach
[u]Unique mechanics[/u] - import real objects & export real home projects to use in real life
[u]Community[/u] – You created something fabulous? Let people rate it and compete in Leaderboard!
[u]Photo mode[/u] – Capture Your Genius and share it! Make people wonder if it's a real-life photo!
[u]VR[/u] - Dive into the world of Dreamhouse!

Join our growing community of Architects on [url=https://linktr.ee/dreamhousegame]Social Media[/url], [url=https://discord.gg/PTb2Dg6Uf7]Discord Server[/url] and add 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1468400/Dreamhouse_The_Game/]Dreamhouse: The Game to Your Wishlist[/url] to stay informed!
